$comment: Chhatri Insurance (fictional). The quote schema and the rating tables, read by the brain (backend/rating.py) and the page (frontend/src/quote/rating.ts). Both compute the same premium; data/quote_cases.json holds golden cases both test suites check. Every number here is invented for the demo.
rounding: Each breakdown line is rounded to the nearest rupee, half up (floor(x + 0.5)). The total is the sum of the rounded lines.

ncb.$comment: No Claim Bonus on own-damage premium, by claim-free years (5 or more = 50%).

fields.label: Car type
fields.ask: Is it a hatchback, a sedan or an SUV?

fields.label: Fuel
fields.ask: Petrol, diesel, CNG or electric?

fields.label: Make and model
fields.ask: Which make and model is it?

fields.label: Registration year
fields.ask: Which year was it registered?

fields.label: Ex-showroom price
fields.ask: Roughly what was the ex-showroom price?

fields.label: City of registration
fields.ask: Which city is it registered in?

fields.label: Claim-free years
fields.ask: How many years in a row without a claim? Five or more counts as five.

fields.label: Voluntary deductible
fields.ask: Would you like a voluntary deductible to lower the premium?

od_rate_percent.$comment: Own-damage rate as % of IDV, by car type, zone and age band [0-4 years, 5-9 years, 10+ years].

method: age = rating_year - registration_year; age band index = 0 if age <= 4, 1 if age <= 9, else 2.
IDV = ex_showroom x (1 - idv_depreciation_by_age[min(age, 5)] / 100), rounded to the nearest 100 (half up).
Own damage = IDV x od_rate_percent[class][zone][band] / 100 x fuel_factor[fuel].
No Claim Bonus = Own damage x ncb.by_years[claim_free_years] / 100 (a discount).
Voluntary deductible discount = (Own damage - NCB) x voluntary_deductible_discount_percent / 100.
Third-party = third_party[class] (x third_party_electric_factor when electric).

Add-on with idv_percent = IDV x idv_percent / 100; idv_percent_by_age = the first [max_age, percent] row with age <= max_age; flat = the amount. An add-on whose max_age < age, or whose min_ncb > the NCB %, is unavailable.
Net premium = sum of the rounded lines (discounts negative). GST = net x gst_percent / 100. Total = net + GST.

fields.label: Voluntary co-pay
fields.ask: Would you take a voluntary co-pay to lower the premium?

addons.label: Maternity cover
addons.requires: family_floater with 2 adults, eldest adult 45 or younger

addons.label: Critical illness (₹5,00,000 lump sum per adult)

base_by_band.$comment: Annual base premium for one adult, by age band, for each sum insured.

method: band = the first age_bands row with eldest_age <= its upper age. individual: adults must be 1 and children 0.
Base premium = base_by_band[sum_insured][band] x (1 + second_adult_factor x (adults - 1) + child_factor x children) x zone_factor[zone].
Pre-existing illness loading = Base x 10% when pre_existing = yes.
Voluntary co-pay discount = (Base + loading) x copay_discount_percent / 100 (a discount).
Add-ons: base_percent = Base x percent / 100; flat; flat_per_adult = amount x adults. maternity is unavailable unless family_floater, adults = 2 and eldest_age <= 45.
GST 0%: total = net.

products.name: Term life insurance
products.gst_note: Individual life insurance premiums are exempt from GST.

fields.label: Your age
fields.ask: How old are you?

fields.label: Gender
fields.ask: May I ask your gender, for the rate table?

fields.label: Tobacco use
fields.ask: Do you smoke or use tobacco?

fields.label: Life cover
fields.ask: How much life cover: 50 lakh, 75 lakh, 1 crore, 1.5 crore or 2 crore?

fields.label: Cover till age
fields.ask: Until what age: 60, 65, 70 or 75?

rate_per_thousand.$comment: Annual premium per ₹1,000 of cover for a male non-smoker, by age band upper bound.

method: cover_till_age - age must be at least 10, or the quote is refused.
Base premium = cover_amount / 1000 x rate (first band with age <= upper) x (smoker_factor if smoker) x (female_factor if female) x term_factor[cover_till_age].
High-cover discount = Base x the first high_cover_discount_percent row with cover_amount >= its threshold (a discount).
Riders: flat; flat_by_age = the first row with age <= its upper age; base_percent = Base x percent / 100.
GST 0%: total = net. The premium is annual.

products.name: Home insurance

fields.label: You are the
fields.ask: Do you own the home or rent it?

fields.label: Property type
fields.ask: Is it an apartment or an independent house?

fields.label: Rebuilding cost of the structure
fields.ask: What would it cost to rebuild the structure? Tenants can say zero.

fields.label: Value of household contents
fields.ask: Roughly what are your household contents worth?

fields.label: Age of the building (years)
fields.ask: How old is the building?

fields.label: City
fields.ask: Which city is the home in?

fields.label: Security system or guarded society
fields.ask: Does it have a security system or a guarded gate?

method: Building premium = building_value / 1000 x building_rate_per_thousand[property_type] x (1.10 if building_age > 25) x zone_factor[zone]. A tenant's building_value must be 0.
Contents premium = contents_value / 1000 x 0.8 x zone_factor[zone].
Security discount = (Building + Contents) x 5% when security_system = yes (a discount).
Add-ons: per_thousand_of = field / 1000 x rate (earthquake needs building_value > 0); flat. rent_loss is unavailable to a tenant.
Net = sum of the rounded lines. GST = net x 18%. Total = net + GST.

products.name: Travel insurance

fields.label: Destination
fields.ask: Where are you travelling: Asia, the Schengen countries, the USA or Canada, or worldwide?

fields.label: Trip length (days)
fields.ask: How many days is the trip?

fields.label: Travellers
fields.ask: How many people are travelling?

fields.label: Age of the eldest traveller
fields.ask: How old is the eldest traveller?

fields.label: Plan
fields.ask: Essential, with US$50,000 medical cover, or Plus, with US$1,00,000?

method: Base = max(per_day_per_traveller[region][plan] x trip_days, min_per_traveller) x travellers x age loading (first row with eldest_age <= its upper age).
Group discount = Base x 10% when travellers >= 3 (a discount).
Add-ons: flat_per_traveller = amount x travellers; base_percent = Base x percent / 100.
Net = sum of the rounded lines. GST = net x 18%. Total = net + GST.
